messages:
elena (Finance): FYI team: finalizing a hosted billing update going live in two weeks. Key points: starter credits for new signups drop from $200 to $75, were introducing soft hosted rate limits (measured per-API-key with account backstops) and a 7-day overage grace window before charging. Invoices will show a 48h overage preview link to reduce surprises. Full doc: https://redwood.internal/billing/q2-update
mike (Eng): Confirm Dedicated/reserved customers unaffected?
elena (Finance): Correct Dedicated under contract are excluded. Soft limits apply to hosted PAYG keys only.
ajay (Platform): How will bursty RAG workloads be handled?
elena (Finance): Sliding-window token tracking, with a burst allowance for verified SDK keys and a form to request temporary higher burst for RAG.
billing-bot: AUTO: `/billing preview <acct>` available. Accounts with projected >$100 overage will get preview emails.
noah (CS): CS will start targeted outreach two weeks before enforcement; playbook in doc.
nina (Legal): Review notification language ASAP.
elena (Finance): Rollout: informational preview now; opt-in beta next week; enforcement (automated throttling + billing) at unix 1763020000. Please escalate blockers to #support-billing.
